localizedValues.name: Camp Delany
localizedValues.description:
Please check availability online. To make a reservation, please obtain a reservation request form at https://parks.wa.gov/find-activities/retreat-centers and email it to Retreat.Centers@parks.wa.gov
Camp Delany Retreat Center can sleep up to 80 people in cabins. Facility may be able to accommodate additional overnight guests in tents and RVs/trailers (no hook-ups) with program staff approval. The lodge has a fully equipped kitchen and large dining hall space. Pots, pans, dishes, utensils, and cleaning supplies are provided. Bring your own bedding, pillows, and towels as linens are not provided. Pets are welcome at Camp Delany Retreat Center. There are 2 pet-friendly cabins. Limit of 2 pets per cabin. Additional fees apply. See Camp Delany Retreat Center page for more details.
